validity.researcher_notes: This directly resolves the batch guidance's flagged concern about P2588's questionable Quebec end-state. The July 9, 2018 FERC notice of application for this exact docket (CP18-506) states Portland Natural Gas 'requests authorization to install one new 6,300 horsepower compressor unit at the existing Eliot Compressor Station located in York County, Maine and modifications to the infrastructure at the existing Westbrook Compressor Station and Dracut Metering and Regulating Station located in Cumberland County, Maine and Middlesex County, Massachusetts respectively.' The Dec 10, 2018 FERC environmental-assessment notice for the same docket independently confirms: 'The Project includes modifications to existing facilities in Cumberland and York Counties, Maine, and Middlesex County, Massachusetts' -- no New Hampshire and no Quebec/Canada facilities are mentioned anywhere in either document. PNGTS's own wholly-owned mainline (the P0242 row) does run from Pittsburg, NH (at the Quebec-adjacent Canadian interconnect with TransCanada PipeLines Limited) to Westbrook, ME, and it is plausible the sheet's Start='New Hampshire'/End='Quebec' on this XPress row is a copy-forward of the mainline's border-interconnect framing rather than this specific compression project's own footprint -- but this project itself touches no NH or Quebec facilities. Recommend the correction above (Maine-to-Massachusetts, reflecting the actual compressor/M&R stations modified) rather than leaving the NH/Quebec framing uncorrected.
